fullDescription: PitchPerfect is a high-energy, dark-themed mobile UI design system specifically crafted for video creators, sports portfolios, and media-heavy entertainment apps. It features a bold, athletic aesthetic characterized by high-contrast red accents (#DC2626), deep slate backgrounds (#020617), and aggressive uppercase typography using Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi. The layout utilizes a bento-style video grid, a featured hero card with gold gradient text (#FDE047 to #EAB308), and a unique bottom tab navigation with a floating, rotated action button. It is optimized for mobile engagement with tactile micro-interactions and a sleek, modern professional look.

structured.summary: A bold, athletic mobile portfolio style guide for video-centric applications, utilizing a deep slate-950 dark mode, vibrant red accents, and heavy editorial typography to create a high-impact professional aesthetic.

style.description: The style is 'Aggressive Editorial'. Typography combines Cabinet Grotesk (Weights: 700, 800, 900) for headers with Satoshi (Weights: 400, 500, 700) for body text. The primary color palette is Slate-950 (#020617) for backgrounds, Red-600 (#DC2626) for primary actions, and a gold text gradient (135deg, #FDE047, #EAB308). Spacing is tight (tracking-tighter) to enhance the athletic feel. UI elements feature large border-radii (up to 2.5rem) and subtle white borders (border-white/5) for depth.
style.prompt:
Create a high-contrast dark mode mobile UI. 
- **Colors**: Background: #020617 (Slate-950); Secondary Background: #0F172A (Slate-900); Primary Accent: #DC2626 (Red-600); Gold Text Gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #FDE047 0%, #EAB308 100%).
- **Typography**: Headers: 'Cabinet Grotesk', font-weight: 900, text-transform: uppercase, letter-spacing: -0.05em. Body: 'Satoshi', font-weight: 500, letter-spacing: -0.025em.
- **Icons**: Use Lucide-style thin/medium stroke icons in slate-400 or red-600.
- **Shadows**: Large Red-600/50 glow on primary buttons; Deep elevation on cards.
- **Micro-interactions**: Active state scale: 0.95; smooth transitions on hover/press; 200ms ease-in-out.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical-scrolling mobile layout with a fixed header and bottom navigation. Content is organized into semantic sections: Profile Overview, Hero/Featured content, Horizontal Category Filter, and a 2-column Video Grid.

prompts.prompt: A fixed top navigation bar. Left side features a logo (Red rounded-square icon with play symbol + 'PITCH PERFECT' text in black/red uppercase). Right side features search and notification icons with a red dot badge on notifications. Padding: 56px top, 24px sides.

Profile header below main nav. Left: Large avatar (48x48px) with a red border and a blue verified badge at bottom-right. Center: Creator name in uppercase bold and subscriber count in slate-500. Right: Pill-shaped 'SUBSCRIBE' button in solid Red-600 with white uppercase text.

Large aspect-ratio (16:10) card with 24px rounded corners. Background: High-quality action image with a bottom-to-top slate-950 gradient overlay. Center: Floating Red-600 play button (64x64px) with heavy shadow. Bottom-left text: Red tag 'FEATURED MASTERPIECE', followed by a large headline using gold-gradient text for keywords.

Horizontal scrolling pill-list. Active item: Red-600 background with white text. Inactive items: Slate-900 background, Slate-400 text, 1px white/5 border. Text: Uppercase, font-size: 10px, tracking-widest.

2-column grid with 16px gap. Each card: 16:9 thumbnail with 16px rounded corners, 1px border. Bottom-right of thumbnail: Black/80 pill with time duration (e.g., '08:20'). Below thumbnail: 2-line title in Satoshi-bold, followed by metadata (views/time) in Slate-500 uppercase.

prompts.partPt: Chamada Final para Ação / Fan Club Section
prompts.prompt: A container with 40px rounded corners (rounded-[2.5rem]). Background: Diagonal gradient from Red-600 to Red-900. Content: Centered bold header, secondary text in Red-100/70. Includes a full-width input field (semi-transparent background) and a white 'Unlock Perks' button with red text.

Fixed height 84px bar in Slate-900 with subtle top border. Four primary items (Home, Discover, Library, Me) using icons and labels in red (active) or slate-500 (inactive). Center 'Upload' button: 56x56px Red-600 square-circle with a 3-degree counter-clockwise rotation, containing a large '+' icon.

special_ui_components.description: A high-visibility floating action button located in the center of the tab bar.
special_ui_components.prompt: A 56x56px container with 16px (rounded-2xl) corners. Background-color: #DC2626. Icon: Lucide-Plus, 30px, white. Transformation: rotate(-3deg). Hover/Active state: rotate(0deg) and scale(0.95). Shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.4).

special_ui_components.description: Selective emphasis on headings for premium feel.
special_ui_components.prompt: Text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text; background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, #fde047 0%, #eab308 100%); used specifically on keywords within H3 headers.
